stem: A university has 1,800 first-year students and 4,200 students in later years. To study gym use, a researcher selected 100 first-year students at random from all first-year students and 150 later-year students at random from all later-year students. The table shows the results. Based on the survey, about how many of the university's later-year students use the campus gym?
solution: The later-year students in the sample were selected at random from all later-year students, so use that group's rate: \(\frac{45}{150} = 0.30\).
Apply it to the 4,200 later-year students: \(0.30 \cdot 4{,}200 = 1{,}260\).
verify:
r = figure['rows']
rate = Rational(int(r[1][2]), int(r[1][1]))
est = rate * 4200
assert est == 1260
assert Rational(int(r[2][2]), int(r[2][1])) * 4200 != est
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [est]
